name: viu
description: View images right from the terminal

name: -w
--width
options.description: Resize the image to a provided width

name: -h
--height
options.description: Resize the image to a provided height

name: -a
--absolute-offset
options.description: Make the x and y offset relative to the top left terminal corner

name: -r
--recursive
options.description: Recurse down directories if passed one

name: -n
--name
options.description: Output the name of the file before displaying

name: -c
--caption
options.description: Output the name of the file after displaying

name: -t
--transparent
options.description: Display transparent images with transparent background

name: -f
--frame-rate
options.description: Play the gif at a given frame rate

name: --once
options.description: Loop only once through the gif

name: -s
--static
options.description: Show only the first frame of the gif
